title: fix(plugin-detail): record:quick_actions draws its refused-array box on preview surfaces only
body:
Fixes #13000
Clause-②: no

## What

`record:quick_actions` drew its dashed "KEY refused at index N (see console)" box in every view when its declared action array was refused (the objectui#7182 rule: a mixed id/object array). A customer on a published page then saw developer copy pointing at a console they cannot read.

Per the triage ruling on the card (comment 6256246172), the box now follows the rule objectui#12995 set for the "no actions configured" placeholder:

- under `PreviewModeProvider` (`usePreviewMode()` true) the refused box is still drawn, unchanged;
- in a runtime view the block draws nothing;
- the `console.error` naming the key, index and rule is unchanged and still fires in both.

The guard in the empty branch of `RecordQuickActionsBody` moves from `declared.kind !== 'refused' && (actions.length > 0 || !authoring)` to `!authoring || (declared.kind !== 'refused' && actions.length > 0)`. How an array is refused, and the withheld / "named none" cases objectui#12995 set, are untouched. The stale `noRecord` comment (it still said the bar "draws its empty state") is corrected, comment only.

## Tests

- `record-quick-actions.declared-action-ids-7182.test.tsx`: the two refused cases now mount under `PreviewModeProvider`, every assertion kept. New case: a refused array (index 2, so the reporter's warn-once ledger cannot silence it) draws nothing at runtime, no placeholder of either kind, empty `textContent`, and the console error still fires once, naming index 2.
- `declaredActionIds.twoRenderers-7182.test.tsx` (in `src/__tests__`, outside the claim's "tests beside it" wording; declared in the report): its refused case mounts both surfaces at runtime, so the bar half now asserts no "refused at index" text and an empty bar. The cross-surface console assertions are unchanged.
- CONTROL: `record-quick-actions.withheldEmpty-12995.test.tsx` is unchanged and green.

Ablation (one-off, no permanent file): restoring the old guard through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `8f3fed2d4f61` to `2ecd76149a17`) turned both runtime pins red (`2 failed | 6 passed`); the restore was proven by blob hash (`8f3fed2d4f61` == HEAD) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

Measured at `b897f7d28b`:

- targeted vitest (3 files): 14 passed; family run (48 test files naming `record-quick-actions` / `record:quick_actions` / `recordQuickActionsInputs` / `recordBinding`): 48 files, 2221 tests passed.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` closure build, then `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the test files): exit 0.
- eslint on the 3 changed files (the package's `eslint .` form): 0 errors, warnings equal to base on each file (12/4/4). eslint config is not type-aware, so the diff cannot move the verdict for an untouched file.
- pre-tsc battery and changeset gates: all exit 0 except `check:spec-floors` exit 1, the known main-side state the dispatch named.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the full `packages/plugin-detail/` directory, declared to CI per the dispatch.

## Acceptance notes

- `src/index.tsx`: the registered `actionNames` description does not describe the refused box at runtime, so it is unchanged.
- The branch commit's message carries a `Fixes objectui#13000` line, which the dev contract keeps out of commits. It names this same card, so a squash changes nothing about which card closes; it is not rewritten (no force-push in this repo).
